turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan. Thank you for calling. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak, or would it be more convenient for us to talk later?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Good morning, Rachel. I am in my office with the door closed, so this is convenient. I have finished a portfolio review and would like to deal with the paperwork while I have some quiet.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. Please provide your identification details before we discuss the account.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I will keep the conversation concise and leave room for any questions you want to raise.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That gives me something to consider. On the administration side, I would appreciate keeping the correspondence easy to scan. Long documents tend to sit unread when the business gets busy.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: What presentation works best when you are reviewing your correspondence? I can note your preference for how we organise the accompanying message.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: A short overview with clear headings is useful, with the full documents kept separate. I still want the complete paperwork available; I just do not want to search through it to find the purpose of a message.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note that presentation preference. Do you usually set aside time for personal administration, or fit it around your business appointments?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Mostly around appointments. I manage the distribution business myself, and deliveries can interrupt the day. I am trying to keep personal correspondence out of the work inbox so it does not get buried among supplier messages.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Let me cover the fund disclosures now. [[EV_001]] [[EV_005]] [[EV_002]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before the final readback, is the secure mailbox convenient for your correspondence? There is no need to give me an email address during this call.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The secure mailbox is convenient. I check it myself, and I would prefer to keep the documents there rather than mix them with business email. That makes my filing easier as well.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I have noted your correspondence preference. I will now read the final instruction for your response. [[EV_007]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. That concludes the telephone discussion. If you have an administrative question about the correspondence, you can contact me through the usual channel.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel. I appreciate keeping the conversation focused. I will look out for the correspondence. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You are welcome. Thank you for your time, and goodbye.
